name: com.hippo.payment.RazorPayment
description: This is Hippo's Razorpay payment entry point: it receives an order and customer details. In the analyzed 4.0.0.8 artifact, it does not launch a checkout screen.
disableEffect: Blocking this entry point can remove Razorpay payments from integrations that use the working implementation; the analyzed 4.0.0.8 build already shows no checkout.
